title: PAF Performance & Operations Contract (Step 24)
description: Makes performance and production-observation requirements durable and testable rather than anecdotal.

workloadDefinitionRule.const: A performance contract without a representative, versioned workload definition is unverifiable and does not count as a contract.

observationRecordRule.const: Production observation after deployment is required evidence, not optional monitoring. Absence of an observation record blocks Stable status.

stableApprovalRule.const: STABLE status requires explicit human approval (approval class STABLE_STATUS) and cannot be inferred from elapsed time without incident.

deploymentEvidenceRule.const: Every deployment produces a deployment record linking the release readiness record, the artifact version deployed, and the environment.

rollbackRule.const: Deployment evidence is incomplete without a verified recovery/rollback procedure per paf.recovery.schema.json. An untested recovery is not a recovery.
